text: I can break an LLM call's cost into input and output tokens and say which lever cuts latency and which cuts cost.
I can design a small-to-large cascade, choose its escalation signal, and compute its cost per query and break-even escalation rate.
I can lay out a prompt so the shared prefix is cacheable and spot a change that breaks prompt caching.
I can argue for and against a semantic cache and scope one so it cannot return another user's answer.
I can calculate how chat history grows token spend and set per-call, per-conversation and per-tenant budgets.
I can work out which provider limit binds and design token-aware rate limiting with priorities and single-layer retries.
